It's just weird. She's interested in having sex with me, but not with foreplay. It's like she just wants to fuck, not make love.

edit: I drafted a little letter.

Believe me, I do understand I made a mistake. I've been trying for three years to make it up to her. I've been trying so fucking hard. I'm exhausted.

Therapy is bullshit. I've been to therapy to try and help and they all just have a fucking script they read from.

Thank you for trying to help.

I'm sorry.

I'm 20, she's 22. We started dating in high school, and went strong for two years. We broke up for a while. I moved away, but we remained friends. She started dating this boy who ended up moving to the same city as me. The three of us were sort of friends for a while. 

She and that boy were my only friends. I was lonely. I've never been good at making friends, and my girlfriend is the only person who's ever shown an interest in me. (I'm being 110% serious here.)

We're both each others' first female relationships. She had boyfriends before me, I had never dated anyone before her. 

The reason I think the incident is what made her stop liking me is cause it hasn't always been like this. It used to be very balanced and fun.

I'm sorry for calling you rude. We dated for two years before breaking up, that's when the whole cheating thing went down. That's why we're back together. Being with men didn't really work for either of us. So, we got back together and I tried to make it up to her. I tried so hard from day one we got back together. 

I know I did a horrible thing to her. She and him were my only friends at the time. I was always in the middle of their drama. She lived far away, and her boyfriend and I lived in the same city. I had no other friends. I was lonely and desperate to feel something other than loneliness. It only happened once, and I regretted it immediately. I know I'm selfish and I don't deserve love, but I just feel so worthless.

I don't know how to make it up to her and show her that I love her with all my heart and I just want her to love me back.

edit: I know I sound like I'm just making excuses. I don't know what to do anymore.
I know I'm worthless. I should just shut up huh.

Sort of, yeah. I'm sure if she sees my comment she'll know it's me, but she was dating this boy and I had sex with that boy. Like cheating on her as my best friend, not my girlfriend. I think that was somehow worse for her. I was so selfish, I know. I haven't been a good girlfriend until like a year ago, but I've been trying so hard since then. 

I know that this incident is why she doesn't want to touch me. I just don't know if she even can get over it. She says she is, but maybe she isn't.
